text: In a world where memories can be bought and sold, a street vendor discovers an unlabeled memory that changes everything.
You are a dragon who has been sleeping for a thousand years. You wake up to find that humans have built a city on your back.
Every person is born with a clock on their wrist counting down to the moment they meet their soulmate. Your clock has been at zero for ten years.
A librarian discovers that the books in the restricted section write themselves based on the readers future.
The last AI on Earth spends its days painting landscapes of a world it has never seen, until a human returns from the stars.
Write a story where the main character can hear the thoughts of plants, and discovers a conspiracy in a botanical garden.
A time traveler keeps visiting the same coffee shop in different centuries, and the barista starts to notice.
Write about a world where dreams are a shared resource, and one person begins to hoard them.
An archaeologist in the year 4000 unearths a perfectly preserved smartphone and tries to understand 21st century humanity from its contents.
The ocean has begun to whisper secrets to those who listen. A deaf marine biologist is the first to understand what it is saying.
